exercises.instruction: How do you feel? Choose the best word from the box.
items: Example: You’ve just had a long holiday with lots of good food and exercise. You feel well.
1 You haven’t eaten for ten hours.
2 You went to bed at 2 am and got up at 6 am.
3 Someone has just broken a window in your new car.
4 It is a hot day and you haven’t had anything to drink for three hours.
5 You have a very bad cold.
6 It is snowing and you do not have a coat with you.
7 You got very good marks in an important exam.
8 It is 35°C and you do not have air conditioning.
9 Your dog has just died.
10 You see your brother’s photo on the front page of the newspaper.

exercises.instruction: What are the opposites of these verbs and adjectives?
items: Example: good bad
1 love    2 cold    3 happy    4 ill
Example: Peter wants that his sister helps him. Peter wants his sister to help him.
1 I like very much tennis.
2 I am very happy for your good exam results.
3 Jack hopes his girlfriend to phone him soon.
4 I like really ice cream.
5 My little sister prefers juice from milk.
6 Grandfather is little tired today.

exercises.instruction: How do these people look? Use the letters to make a word and finish the sentence.
items: Example: Liz looks O T H. Liz looks hot.
1 Bonnie looks T U S E P.
2 Colin looks G A R Y N.
3 Stan looks D A S.
4 Katie looks L I L.
5 Mark looks P E S S I D U R.
6 Rob looks L C D O.
7 Nat looks D I R T E.
8 Clare looks P A P H Y.
9 Spot looks R I T T Y S H.
10 Fluffy looks G H U R Y N.
